<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom (Init-only L2 core via UnifiedDrawdown, zero Unrestricted/Valuation). EmbodiedConversion derives uptake from dissipative/unit reproduction lower bounds under upper-bounded replenishment.
- Multi-site World.ReadOffExchange requires non-zero draw admissibility on all active sites and pre-overdraw positivity for Flow balance equality; nested_transition_raises_among assumes Founding.Nested Founded and Sequestered.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That real biological lineages satisfy EmbodiedConversion unit-uptake floors or Founding.Nested sequestration (empirical recognition under AGENTS.md Rule 2).
- Stochastic mutation-selection PDEs beyond discrete finite-cohort Nat generation models.
- **Counterexample:** DerivedEmbodiedDrawWitness & MultiSiteBridgeWitness: SurplusRun drops 13->12->9->1->0 from selection surplus while SteadyRun persists at 13; UncheckedTwoSite overdraws site true (Nat clamping vs pre-overdraw balance) while SafeTwoSite holds. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/EvolutionaryDrawdown.lean)
- **Counterexample:** MajorTransitionWitness: unintegrated fast drawers collapse 9->8->3->0 (unint_takeover_ends), whereas OpenComposition hide/hideContract holds internal site viable 9->8->8... and shifts concordAmong = 4 (concordWithin = 0). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/EvolutionaryDrawdown.lean)
